mapper.select: SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS roomStatusOperationLogId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, r.room_name AS roomName, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.source_type AS sourceType, om.status AS orderStatus, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, CAST(ca.channel_id AS CHAR) AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, COALESCE(gm.name, rc.name) AS channelRoomCategoryProductName, COALESCE(pu.nick_name, CAST(om.created_by AS CHAR)) AS userName, om.created_at AS createTime, om.remark AS remark FROM order_main om JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = om.camp_id AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id AND r.camp_id = om.camp_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN goods_main gm ON gm.goods_id = om.goods_id AND gm.camp_id = om.camp_id AND gm.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pms_user pu ON pu.user_id = om.created_by AND pu.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.room_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY om.created_at DESC, om.order_id DESC
